subject: Capacity MAP & action plan for AtlasHealth pilot (GPU reservation timeline)
messages:
From: Eve Barnes <eve.barnes@atlashealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: AtlasHealth pilot - capacity & MAP request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with latency and the routing controls. Procurement asked me to get a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that clearly spells out:
- target pilot capacity (GPU count and type)
- lead times for Dedicated/Private deployments
- evaluation milestones and acceptance criteria
- procurement/contract milestones and expected DocuSign timing

Can you share a short MAP draft and an honest estimate for procurement lead times? We’re targeting a Q2 pilot start but need to align internal approvals.

Thanks,
Eve Barnes
Procurement Manager, AtlasHealth
attachments: none
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Barnes <eve.barnes@atlashealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -0500
Subject: RE: AtlasHealth pilot - capacity & MAP request

Hi Eve — great to hear the demo landed well. I attached a first-pass MAP for the pilot (MAP_AtlasHealth_v1.xlsx) and a one‑page eval schedule (eval-schedule.pdf). Key highlights:

- Recommended pilot pool: 8 x H100 (20GB) equivalent GPUs for a 6-week functional + load evaluation.
- Alternate smaller config: 4 x A100 (40GB) if you want lower committed spend during initial eval.
- Dedicated/Private lead time: 10–14 weeks from signed contract to customer-ready VPC with dedicated GPU pool; 4–6 weeks for hosted Dedicated if using existing reserved racks.
- Critical path: procurement PO -> signed SOW/DocuSign -> infra provisioning -> security onboarding (KMS, audit logs).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred GPU family (H100 vs A100) and whether you want on-prem or VPC Private.
2) We set internal milestones for signatures (target DocuSign before 2027-02-24 to hit Q2 pilot).
3) Schedule a 30-min alignment call next week to lock the MAP.

Notes on sizing: the 8 x H100 recommendation is conservative to keep tail latencies low under mixed workloads (embedding + chat). If you share expected concurrent sessions and average token lengths I can refine the numbers.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0184
attachments: MAP_AtlasHealth_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-schedule.pdf (pdf)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Eve Barnes <eve.barnes@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0500
Subject: RE: AtlasHealth pilot - capacity & MAP request

Eve / Jasmine — quick engineering note to shape expectations:

- If AtlasHealth needs strict data residency and an on-prem appliance, plan for the longer lead time (14–18 weeks) due to shipping and onsite setup.
- For VPC Private deployments we can often do a 10–12 week window if network peering and KMS access are ready at signing.
- GPU sizing: 8 x H100 is targeted at ~600 concurrent short-chat sessions or ~200 large-context evals. If the pilot goal is accuracy validation rather than scale testing, drop to 4 H100 + burstable hosted capacity to reduce committed spend.

Suggested milestone timeline (compressed):
- Week 0: PO issued / SOW sent (DocuSign)
- Weeks 1–4: Contract + security onboarding (SOC2 evidence + KMS)
- Weeks 5–8: Provisioning + smoke tests
- Weeks 9–12: Pilot execution (functional + load)

Marcus, can you confirm whether we have 8-H100 blocks available in us-west-2 for a May pilot window?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
attachments: none

Thanks — the MAP and timeline look reasonable. A few quick clarifications before we lock the PO:

- We prefer the VPC Private option (don't want on-prem for the pilot).
- We’ll sign for the 8 x H100 pilot but would like a contractual clause to scale down to 4 x H100 within the first 30 days if usage is below the agreed thresholds.
- Procurement confirms our internal approval window is 3 weeks from PO submission, so the target DocuSign before 2027-02-24 is tight but doable.

Action items:
- Jasmine: please send a short SOW + DocuSign link with the 8 x H100 pilot and the scale-down clause.
- Laura / Marcus: confirm capacity availability (8 H100 in us-west-2) and whether we can enable burst-to-hosted during pilot.

We’re excited to move quickly on this.

—Eve
Procurement Manager, AtlasHealth
